threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still stand waiting for the bus at the stop instead of knowing to just walk down the street to catch it at the next crossing.
Last night on the 77, a guy in a full tuxedo argued with the driver about the route. No idea where he was heading, but the whole bus seemed invested.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a group of kids swapping stories about their grandparents' bakery in Turkish, I realized this place has layers that run deep.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a café that doubles as a pet adoption center—grab a coffee while cats roam freely, looking for homes!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their reaction to BART delays—it's just a shrug and a resigned laugh, not panic like the newcomers.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy dressed as a hot dog trying to explain to Muni drivers why the bus couldn't move. Meanwhile, the dog on the tracks was just chilling.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the parks, but it's really the little bodega conversations over vermut that define our vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at the metro ticket machines. They still scan for prices like it’s a luxury item instead of a daily travel necessity.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look for a seat on the bus before spotting the standing crowd piling in. It's like a game you haven't learned yet.
On the 59 last night, a couple argued about which chicken shop is best. Ended with one yelling, 'You wouldn’t know good wings if they slapped you!'

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found a rogue cat lounging on my balcony, looking more at home than I ever did.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a bustling market where the scent of spices mingles with the sound of a spontaneous street concert. It’s like a sensory carnival every weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they can name every taco stand open past midnight but still complain about the new BART delays like it’s a personal offense.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo waiting for the 18 at 2 AM, tapping his watch like he had somewhere to be. Only in SF do you see a formal wear Muni wait.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that most locals avoid Plaça del Sol during the day; it’s too noisy with street performers—better to go at night.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stand at the corner of Carrer de Fraternitat, confused by which way to look for the tram.
